user_value: Kent runs one ship batch that dispatches dev entities to Conductor cloud through spacedock, from any adopter repository, without a hand-written message or a hardcoded model.
hypothesis: If we make the dispatch station build its message from a dev entity's stage and fix the five portability defects the adopter found, then a repository with its own ship state root dispatches two lanes to Conductor cloud through the stations, and the next batch here needs no FO rewrite of a PR body or an inline without-it pair.
wedge: kc-claude-plugins only; Kent as Captain; #399 (DEV-152, adopter-authored) enters at accepted; DEV-156 first because it changes what the other stations receive; then DEV-151, DEV-153, DEV-154, DEV-155. Not in it: DEV-150, nesting a first-officer session in the cloud workspace (#191's recorded ideal), the docs/plan-flow move (DEV-121, the kc-plan-flow session).
outcome: fenced-dispatch.sh obtains its message from spacedock dispatch build and passes the stage's model; open-pr.sh writes the pr-merge body; intent.sh/holder.sh derive branch and remote from the state checkout; e2e-gate.py takes root and flows dir as arguments; the FO skill resolves scripts from the plugin root; the accept station records an absent-at-base path the candidate adds; contract-test covers each.
falsifier: Any of: a station still needs the FO to rewrite its output by hand in this batch's own PRs; #399's state-branch test does not fail when the hardcode is restored; a dispatched fixture task's model does not reach the create call; the adopter's ship root still pushes onto dev's branch.
premises: The six defects are on origin/main 781f9624 as verified by command (station 0).
spacedock dispatch build --entity-path/--stage exists and emits a dispatch artifact (relay#191; to be re-verified by DEV-156's worker with --help).
The relay session's #399 is confined to kc-ship-flow/ and carries a falsified test.
exit: DEV-156, DEV-151, DEV-152 (#399), DEV-153, DEV-154, DEV-155 merged on main with contract-test green.
This batch's own PRs opened by open-pr.sh with template bodies, and its accept blocks need no inline pair duplication for new test files.
kc-ship-flow released (DEV-128 handled) so adopters install the fixed stations.

journey.persona: Kent as Captain; the relay session as adopter
journey.start: a batch member in a second repository cannot be dispatched
journey.end: two lanes dispatched from one batch through spacedock
journey.observable: intent files on spacedock-state/ship, each with the stage's model
